lines.say: muscle creatine stores rise, used to remake ATP (cell energy) in intense effort
bigger strength gains than training alone, under 50 (23 trials, mostly men)
better performance in repeated short, intense bursts like sprints and lifts
more lean mass and slightly more strength with training in adults over 50
little value for endurance; gains in women not significant (only 3 trials)
creatinine rises, so kidney tests can look worse than they are
checked in older or ill long-term users; cystatin C avoids the creatinine effect
weight gain, mainly from water retention
little safety data in kidney disease; reviewers advise against it if function is very low

ask: Should my kidney function be checked before I start, and should future tests use cystatin C because creatine raises creatinine?
